_source: docs/design/design-addendum-v1.md, Core combat systems / Vessel switching / Death, saving, difficulty. Every gameplay number lives here (decision D-003).

primary_moves._note: Story 057, decision D-068. An attack pressed during a dodge's cancel window or up to dash_slash_window_s after it ends is the Vessel's dash slash (data primary.dash); up + attack is the rising cut (primary.up); attacks in the air chain through primary.air. Vessels without these keys use their plain chain. attack_buffer_s (story 060): an attack pressed during a swing is kept this long and starts the next swing as soon as it may.

movement._note: Story 054 (D-063): jump_velocity 14.5 m/s with gravity 30 rises about 3.3 m in play (3.5 m by v^2/2g, less at 60 physics steps a second; was 2.2), so a ledge 3 cells up is reached with room to spare and a 4-cell wall still needs a wall-jump or a mushroom. fall_gravity_mult: gravity is this much stronger while falling, so the body is pulled back down with weight. Story 060: walk_mult is the slow walk's share of the run speed (Shift held, or a stick pushed less than walk_axis_threshold); crouch_mult the speed while crouching (down held on the ground); crouch_hurt_share the share of the body's height that can still be hit while crouching (chest-high bolts and beams pass over).

traversal._note: Story 021, decision D-029. wall_slide_max_fall_mps: fall speed while pressing into a wall. wall_jump_velocity: [away from the wall, up] in m/s. wall_jump_lock_s: seconds steering is ignored after a wall-jump, so the kick carries. wall_coyote_s: seconds after leaving a wall a wall-jump still works. bounce_height_m: apex above a bounce mushroom's cap. void_damage_fraction: share of max HP lost on falling out of a room. void_depth_m: metres below the room bottom that counts as out. spike_damage_fraction (story 054): share of max HP lost touching spikes, before returning to safe ground.

shield_ward._note: Story 023, decision D-030. The statue beam: height above the statue base, length, damage per tick to a player standing in it unguarded, the reflect angle off Caelan's shield, how long the reflected ray must rest on the crystal, how fast an interrupted charge fades, and the crystal size (w, h).

root_prison._note: Story 025, addendum zone table: Nyra is freed from the roots in room 8. Three blows cut the roots (one per thick root drawn), then interact frees her.

root_snare._note: Story 022, addendum resolved contradictions: the Husk's root-snare holds 2.5 s; 6 taps of attack, jump or dodge break it; a Shadowstep breaks it at once.

death._note: Seconds the fallen body stays on screen before the fade to the rested altar (story 018).

water._note: Story 031, decision D-040. move_mult: run speed while swimming. stroke_mps: upward kick of a jump pressed under water. surface_jump_mult: jump out from the surface. gravity_mult, buoyancy (m/s2 upward below float_depth), drag, max_sink_mps, max_rise_mps: the swim_vy rule. swim_depth_m: depth at which the body counts as swimming. freeze_s: life of a Frost-frozen patch; freeze_reach_m: how far below a Frost field the surface may be and still freeze.

darkness._note: Story 043, decision D-050. radius_m: light around the player with an empty Soul Gauge; gauge_bonus_m: extra metres at a full gauge. lamp_radius_m: each lamp (and each T/Y light in a dark room). cue_radius_m: light around an enemy showing an attack cue, so telegraphs are never hidden. depth: how black the dark is (0-1). fade_s: fade in/out.

slide._note: Story 043, decision D-050. friction: share of gravity along the slope that pushes you (0-1). uphill_penalty: how much running uphill slows you per sin(angle). max_slide_mps: top speed while coasting downhill with no input (there is no braking on a slope).

overdrive._note: Story 046, decision D-053. With Overdrive unlocked (the Pure Soul Matrix) and a full gauge (cost_bars), the Ultimate input starts Overdrive: the active Vessel's Ultimate, a free swap, the next Vessel's Ultimate, then a finisher of finisher_radius_m with both Vessels' elements. guard_s: invulnerability refreshed at each step.
